propositions: Clients using rebar CLI without a checkout encounter unresolvable internal cross-references in CLI-served guides (consumer-relative paths like `review-policy.md`, `docs/commit-ticket-trailer.md`).
The commit-trailer format specification (EXPECTED_FORMAT from verify_commit.py) has no CLI-discoverable home; only `rebar verify-commit-ticket --help` surfaces it.
Dangling guide references must be repointed to either sibling guides via `rebar explain <topic>` or repo docs via canonical hosted https://github.com/navapbc/rebar URLs.
A new packaged guide `commit-ticket-trailer.md` must be added to the registry and served via `rebar explain commit-trailer`.
A guard test must prevent regression by asserting no packaged guide contains consumer-relative link targets (only https://, http://, #anchors, or mailto: allowed).
The MCP explain_criterion tool must include commit-trailer in its docstring so the guide is discoverable to MCP clients.
